title: Parallel Matrix Operations

tasks.description: Parallel matmul - implement parallel matrix multiplication with row/column chunking
Parallel element-wise ops - implement parallel add, subtract, multiply, divide
Parallel reduce (sum, max, etc.) - implement parallel reduction operations
Parallel map - implement parallel map operation for arbitrary transformations
Threshold-based dispatch - implement automatic parallel vs sequential decision based on size
Parallel operation benchmarks - measure speedup for various matrix sizes and operations
Parallel tests - verify correctness of parallel operations against sequential reference

successCriteria: Parallel matmul achieves >2x speedup for 1000x1000 matrices
Parallel element-wise ops scale with worker count
Threshold dispatch correctly chooses parallel vs sequential
All parallel operations match sequential results
notes: Sprint 10 completes the parallel matrix operations layer. Features include: dedicated operation modules (matmul, elementwise, reduce, map) with clean APIs, threshold-based dispatch strategy for automatic parallel vs sequential decision, and comprehensive tests (155 total parallel tests). Operations include parallelMatmul, parallelMatvec, parallelTranspose, parallelOuter, parallelDot, parallelAdd/Subtract/Multiply/Divide, parallelScale, unary math functions (abs, sqrt, exp, log, sin, cos, tan), statistical operations (sum, mean, min, max, variance, std, norm, distance, histogram), and generic map/filter/find/sort/reduce. Benchmarks deferred to a later sprint.
